name: GhostSwitch
description: Headless on/off switch. useGhostSwitch owns v-model, APG switch semantics, disabled/readonly, and form submit/reset; GhostSwitch is the thin unstyled button. Themed visual props live on @ghostvue/themes.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial on/off when modelValue is omitted. Form reset restores this mounted value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Native disabled: not focusable, not operable, and not submitted.

props.name: form
props.description: Associates the hidden input with an external form id.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Controlled on/off. Omit for uncontrolled mode.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. Submits name=value while on and enabled.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Focusable and submitted, but not user-operable. Expressed as aria-readonly.

props.name: value
props.description: Submitted string when on. Same default as a native checkbox.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Optional inner content, usually a visible name. Prefer a label for=id or aria-label when the name should not sit inside the control. Do not put On/Off in the name.

exposed.name: blur
exposed.description: Removes focus from the native button when it is mounted. No-op before mount.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: The native switch button after mount; null before mount and after unmount.

exposed.name: focus
exposed.description: Focuses the native button when it is mounted and enabled. No-op before mount.

exposed.name: toggle
exposed.description: User-activation toggle. No-op when disabled or readonly.

parts.name: thumb
parts.description: Decorative thumb inside the track. aria-hidden.

states.name: checked
states.description: Switch is on. Pair with aria-checked=true.

states.name: unchecked
states.description: Switch is off. Pair with aria-checked=false.

keyboard.Space: Toggle the switch when it is enabled and not readonly.
keyboard.Enter: Toggle the switch when it is enabled and not readonly. Implemented because the host is a native button; APG lists Enter as optional.
